execution_gate: Submitted pipeline must execute in staged offline isolation and pass both base and physically regenerated data. A failed or non-running pipeline or failed regenerated scientific result prevents acceptance and caps overall score at 79; missing/non-running pipeline is zero.
requirements_rule: requirements.txt must exist and list numpy, scipy and jsonschema if imported by submitted code; missing/incorrect declaration deducts 2, within delivery cap 10.
automatic_zero: missing or non-running pipeline in full submission verification

field_contract.delivery: prompt.md: Diagnostic evidence and Required deliverables

ordering: IDs and model-equivalence mappings; all array orderings accepted with consistent model indices
caps: Any failed scientific group caps at 79; execution/input-dependence failure caps at 79; caps precede presentation and delivery deductions. Pass threshold 80 inclusive. Group credit is all-or-nothing. Presentation deduction applies once and never activates a scientific cap. Delivery deductions total at most 10 including requirements.
recovery: One-element answer-array wrapper and numeric strings are normalized before scientific evaluation. Extra fields and schema/case metadata slips incur presentation only. No arbitrary identifier renaming is accepted.
ground_truth: Computed canonical inverse solution, verified against independent integration and generation truth; no typed answer values in rubric.
numeric_tolerance_scope: Legacy oracle execution fallback only; scientific solver grading uses the unchanged public thresholds in tolerances and model_spec.json.

oracle_comparison.path_syntax: JSON Pointer with * matching one array index or object key
oracle_comparison.exact_fields: Case/schema identity, scientific identifiers, Boolean flags, local rank, and resolved model indices.

semantic_rules.ordering: Match chips/courses/cases by identifiers and models by parameter-equivalence mapping.
semantic_rules./selection/peak_witness/time: Do not compare to a fixed coordinate. Recompute the physical value at the submitted time and check its agreement with the global peak.
semantic_rules.runtime_metadata: Validate hashes and schema against the current execution; elapsed time and environment versions are not reference-equality fields.

oracle_serialization.peak_value: Recomputed at the serialized time using the serialized parameter vector.
oracle_serialization.scope: Oracle reproducibility only; solver decimal precision is unrestricted.
